summary: The Archeologist’s lateral pickaxe occupation reaches dig.c:dig, but js/dig.js explicitly skips its lateral arm. C accumulates effort, breaks through the secret door, updates terrain and vision, and prints the resulting message. Port the complete dig function across lateral and downward branches from the C source, preserving its occupation return and state transitions.

source.branch: dig first validates the worn tool and current digging target, then checks downward or lateral material, fumbling, and effort accumulation. The lateral completion arm at effort >100 converts secret doors, walls, doors, trees, and rocks with distinct terrain, billing, trap, vision, and message effects. The selected case uses a pickaxe on a secret door; JS dig has a source gap for all lateral occupation progress.
callers: apply.c:use_pick_axe sets the dig occupation, which calls dig.c:dig on subsequent hero turns; js/dig.js:dig is the production occupation callback but records note_unported(dig.c dig lateral occupation).
dependencies: dig.c:dig_check, digcheck_fail_message, and dig_typ already have JavaScript counterparts in js/dig.js. Preserve shared svc.context.digging effort, quiet, level, and position fields across the occupation.

C dig returns one while the occupation continues and zero when done; its caller consumes that return. Source branches include Fumbling, traps, shops, and terrain/vision updates beyond the selected secret door.
